snippet.title: Wicked Night: Holy Knights - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4392550/Wicked_Night_Holy_Knights/?curator_clanid=40645616

Lead your army, shape their bonds, and watch those connections come alive on the battlefield as you fight to prevent the Wicked Night from spreading across Solance.

Inventory management is simple to grasp, but full of meaningful decisions. Each unit carries a flexible loadout with 4 weapons, 4 items, 1 boot and 1 shield slot that let you shape their role in battle.

There’s no durability to worry about, and consumables fully refill each chapter, so you’re free to use your best tools without hesitation. Every SINGLE piece of equipment can be reforged, unlocking new effects that open more strategic options.

Developer: Blindcoco Studios
